result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: it provides a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees and $1 million, mutually excludes indirect and consequential damages, and makes all specified carve-outs uncapped. It also excludes the Company’s identified payment obligations from capped damages. Because the original agreement contained no liability limitation, adding a new provision was necessary and does not alter the unrelated headings and counterparts language. The drafting is clear and professional.
